What they're bringing

About Oh So Peachy

Oh So Peachy is a food trailer cafe serving pancakes (plain or filled), samosas, smoothies and raw juices, plus heartier plates like stir-fry, Thai curry and wraps.

The raw juice menu includes Green Machine (celery, cucumber, apple), Apple Home (apple, ginger, lemon), Beetroot Energy (beetroot, carrot, apple, ginger) and Golden Love (turmeric, apple, orange, lemon, ginger, cayenne pepper) — fresh ingredients, made with love, supporting local.
